description.value: Kasugai Gardens is a public Japanese-style garden in downtown Kelowna, named after Kelowna's sister city Kasugai, Japan. Admission is free per OSM tags, making it an accessible rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan. The garden offers a quiet, landscaped environment in an urban setting.
